Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Account Executive, SMB Grower team is a highly consultative sales team that is responsible for the growth and retention of Stripe’s largest and fastest growing SMB customers. As an Account Executive, SMB Grower team member, you’ll identify new opportunities for our clients to get the most out of Stripe by quickly understanding our clients’ needs, execute scaled sales strategies to close upsell and renewals with existing Stripe customers, and drive end-to-end campaigns to increase adoption of Stripe’s offerings. This role requires a fluency in both French and English and can be either in-office (Toronto) or remote. 

What you’ll do

Responsibilities

  • Own contract renewals and lead negotiations to increase and retain existing customer revenue and Stripe market share
  • Develop and implement full sales cycle strategies for driving product adoption, net new product sales, and client retention at scale among existing Stripe customers
  • Solve complex client needs and work across product, sales, risk, and operations teams to improve our product
  • Own the full sales cycle from lead to close for startups and small/medium businesses
  • Generate your own leads through cold calling, blitzing, research, networking, and driving your territory.
  • Make every potential Stripe user happy with every interaction, regardless of deal size
  • Identify and understand users’ pain points to propose Stripe solutions
  • Make sure that internal teams are set up for users’ success by coordinating with other Stripe teams

Who you are

We’re looking for a well-rounded strategic seller who can build strong relationships with Stripe’s users and manage high velocity deal cycles. If you’re hungry, smart, persistent, and a great teammate, we want to hear from you!

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in a client-facing/sales role
  • Ability to understand complex technical ecosystems and build great relationships with technical users
  • Ability to drive and close upsell opportunities for additional Stripe products in long-term, consultative engagements
  • Analytical ability to manage complex pricing and cost considerations
  • Experience managing projects with input from cross-functional teams
  • A knack for working well with a wide range of stakeholders, both internally and externally
  • Ability and motivation to operate in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment
  • Superior verbal and written communication skills in English and French

Preferred qualifications

  • Prior experience in a sales and/or customer-facing role at a high growth technology company
  • Experience with Excel and SQL, or a willingness to learn
descriptions.job-10wkw7n:
Our Business Development Managers build long-term relationships with financial institutions and public sector organizations to help them prevent and investigate financial crime and address risk and compliance challenges. You’ll work with leading Japanese banks, securities firms, and other financial institutions to connect their business priorities with Chainalysis solutions across financial crime threat intelligence, anti-money laundering (AML), compliance, investigations, fraud prevention, and security.

This role focuses on a select group of priority institutions, building on existing relationships and opportunities rather than starting solely through outbound prospecting. You’ll help customers evaluate how Chainalysis can support their current needs and the responsible development of on-chain finance, including tokenized assets, digital payments, and custody services. While financial institutions are the primary focus, you’ll also support selected public sector opportunities where your expertise can help the Japan team address financial crime, compliance, and investigative needs.

You’ll work alongside Account Executives and specialists across Chainalysis to develop long-term account strategies, prepare proposals, and support customer evaluation, internal approvals, procurement, and implementation planning. Success means advancing strategic opportunities, expanding customer adoption, and contributing to the Japan team’s commercial results.

We are looking for a Business Development Manager to join our Japan team, reporting to the Country Manager, Japan. This is an individual contributor role with no people management responsibilities.

In This Role, You'll

  • Develop and execute strategic business development plans for priority Japanese banks and financial institutions, building on existing relationships and opportunities.

  • Build trusted relationships with executives and stakeholders across business strategy, financial crime, AML, compliance, risk, technology, and operations.

  • Understand customers’ business plans, regulatory requirements, and onchain finance strategies, and translate their needs into clear proposals and practical roadmaps.

  • Partner with Account Executives to advance strategic opportunities and support customers through evaluation, internal approvals, procurement, and contract execution.

  • Help customer stakeholders evaluate options, build internal consensus, and reach informed decisions.

  • Develop proposals that connect Chainalysis solutions across compliance, investigations, fraud prevention, security, and visibility into fund flows.

  • Work with Solutions Architecture, Product, Global Services, Marketing, and Government Affairs to develop customer use cases, proof of value success criteria, and implementation plans.

  • Collaborate with systems integrators and other partners on joint proposals, co-selling, solution integration, implementation, and customer training.

  • Identify opportunities to expand Chainalysis adoption across customer business units, subsidiaries, and services as their needs grow.

  • Work with Government Affairs to understand regulatory developments and support appropriate dialogue with regulators and industry associations.

  • Partner with Account Executives and technical specialists to develop proposals and advance selected opportunities with regulators, government agencies, and law enforcement, supporting customer evaluation, procurement, and contract execution.

  • Share customer and market insights with the Japan team to strengthen positioning, prioritize opportunities, and support commercial planning.

We're Looking For Candidates Who Have

  • Experience working with major Japanese financial institutions in business development, strategic account management, consulting, technology sales, or business transformation.

  • A track record of building trusted relationships with executives and business leaders and helping stakeholders reach informed decisions.

  • Experience advancing strategic opportunities involving multiple stakeholders, long buying cycles, and enterprise procurement processes.

  • The ability to understand business, operational, regulatory, and risk challenges and translate them into practical proposals and customer outcomes.

  • A strong understanding of Japanese financial services industry dynamics, internal approval processes, and budget cycles.

  • Experience collaborating with sales teams and technical specialists to develop opportunities and deliver commercial results.

  • Strong business communication and presentation skills in Japanese, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly to executive audiences.

  • The ability to collaborate with global colleagues in English.

  • An interest in on-chain finance and a willingness to learn about emerging financial technologies, relevant regulation, and Chainalysis solutions. Prior blockchain expertise is not required.

  • The ability to work independently, prioritize strategic opportunities, and bring colleagues and partners together around shared customer priorities.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in banking, securities, trust banking, payments, or another financial institution before moving into consulting, business development, or technology sales.

  • Experience with financial crime threat intelligence, AML/CFT, KYC, sanctions, fraud prevention, transaction monitoring, investigations, or risk management.

  • Experience selling or advising on enterprise software, data, RegTech, FinTech, or cybersecurity solutions.

  • Experience partnering with systems integrators on joint proposals, co-selling, integration, implementation, or embedding technology into customer services.

  • Familiarity with stablecoins, tokenized deposits, tokenized assets, digital securities, custody, or onchain and cross-border payments.

  • Experience working with Japanese public sector organizations, including an understanding of their decision-making, procurement, and budget processes.

  • Familiarity with structured enterprise sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC or Challenger.

  • An established network of senior stakeholders across Japan’s financial services and technology sectors.

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

Who We Are:

Galaxy Digital Inc. (Nasdaq: GLXY) is a global leader in digital assets and data center infrastructure, growing the economy that runs on code. Galaxy delivers the onchain infrastructure that connects institutions to digital assets, including trading, advisory, asset management, staking, self-custody, and tokenization. Galaxy also develops and operates data center infrastructure to power AI and HPC workloads. Anchored by its Helios campus in Texas, Galaxy is building a multi-gigawatt pipeline of more than 5.7 GW of potential capacity, positioning it among the largest and fastest-growing data center developers in North America.

The Company is headquartered in New York City, with offices across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Additional information about Galaxy's businesses and products is available on www.galaxy.com.

We are a diverse team of free thinkers, and fast movers united to help investors and creators energize the global economy. We are looking for individuals who thrive in a culture of builders and overachievers and embrace high performance, transparent feedback, and a mission-first approach. Our culture shapes our way of working and gets us where we want to be.

  • Seek Excellence.

Here are some of the industry-leading benefits of interning at Galaxy:

  • Free daily snacks and weekly lunches

About the Company

Rain is the global stablecoin payments platform for enterprises, neobanks, platforms, developers, and AI agents. Our technology allows partners to move, store, and use stablecoins instantly and compliantly through global payment cards, rewards, on/offramps, wallets, and cross-border rails. As both a Visa and Mastercard Principal Member, Rain issues cards that work at more than 175 million merchant locations in over 220 countries and territories. Built natively for stablecoins and trusted by more than 100 organizations worldwide, Rain delivers secure, scalable infrastructure that makes money move freely and instantly around the world.

You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company backed by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS. In January 2026, we closed a $250M Series C led by ICONIQ, valuing Rain at $1.95B, with Sapphire Ventures, Norwest, Galaxy Ventures, Dragonfly, Bessemer Venture Partners, FirstMark, Lightspeed, and Endeavor Catalyst also participating. If you're curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial future, we'd love to talk.

Our Ethos

We believe in an open and flat structure. You will be able to grow into the role that most aligns with your goals. Our team members at all levels have the freedom to explore ideas and impact the roadmap and vision of our company.

About the Team

Events are an essential piece of Rain's growth strategy, as they're where we meet new partners and deepen relationships with the ones we already have.

The events team sits within Marketing and Communications and is led by our Events Manager, who runs Rain's events globally. Our calendar covers major industry conferences like Money20/20, where we run booths and side events, along with events we host ourselves, such as workshops at our New York office and dinners co-hosted with partners in cities ranging from Singapore to Mexico City. That calendar keeps growing as Rain expands into new markets. You'll help make sure every event on it is well run and worth the investment.

What you’ll do

  • Coordinate logistics for several events at once, from conference booths and sponsorships to the dinners and side events we host. You'll source venues and manage vendor contracts, and you'll make sure booth materials and swag arrive where they need to be.

  • Book hotels and travel for the Rain team at each event, and keep everyone's plans organized in one place.

  • Build the Know Before You Go (KBYG) decks that prepare our team for each event, covering the agenda, booth staffing, planned meetings, and the people we want to connect with there.

  • Track timelines and spend for each event, including vendor invoices, so nothing slips between planning and wrap-up.

  • Keep comms moving while our Events Manager is onsite. You'll field questions from internal teams and vendors and flag anything that needs a quick decision.

  • Work with our sales and partnerships teams to understand which partners and prospects matter most for each event, and help shape guest lists and invitations around them.

  • Travel to support events onsite, from booth setup to running check-in at a hosted dinner.

  • Pitch ideas for events and formats we should try, and help report on results like attendance and meetings booked so each event informs the next one.

  • Jump in wherever the work needs you, whether that's packing gift bags the night before a conference or rebooking hotels when plans change.

You are likely to succeed if you have:

  • 1+ years of hands-on event experience, ideally at a startup, fintech, crypto/web3 company, or agency. You've worked conference booths, sponsorships, or hosted events and have seen at least one through from start to finish.

  • A track record of hard work and organization. You can juggle several events at once and keep contracts, venues, hotel bookings, KBYG decks, swag, and shipping on schedule without losing track of the details.

  • The ability to stay calm under pressure. When plans change on the day of an event, you solve the problem quickly and keep partners and teammates in the loop.

  • Curiosity about stablecoins and payments, or excitement to learn fast. You can hold a good conversation with fintech, crypto, and enterprise partners at a co-hosted dinner or side event, and you understand why who's in the room matters.

  • Creative instincts grounded in the business. You want to understand what each event needs to achieve for Rain, and you bring ideas that help it get there.

  • A low-ego, roll-up-your-sleeves attitude. One day you're stuffing gift bags and the next you're pitching an event we should host. You're proactive and you like working somewhere that moves fast.

  • Strong working relationships with internal teams and outside vendors. You communicate clearly and represent Rain professionally with everyone you work with.

  • Willingness to travel regularly, both domestically and internationally, and flexibility around event schedules.

Bonus attributes:

  • Experience working major fintech or crypto conferences such as Money20/20, and a feel for how that circuit runs.

  • Experience shipping booth materials and swag internationally, including customs paperwork.

  • Familiarity with event registration and CRM tools like Luma or HubSpot.

  • An eye for design that shows up in booth layouts and swag choices.

Things that enable a fulfilling, healthy and happy experience at Rain:

Flexible time off 🌴 Unlimited vacation can be daunting, so we require Rainmakers to take 10 days minimum for themselves.

Flexible working ☕ We support a flexible workplace – work from home, come into an office, or both. We want everyone to work in an environment where they're their most confident and productive selves. New Rainmakers receive a stipend to set up a comfortable home workspace.

Easy to access benefits 🧠 For US Rainmakers, we cover 95% of your health, dental, and vision plan costs and 90% for your dependents, plus a 100% company-subsidized life insurance plan.

Retirement goals💡 Plan for the future with confidence. We offer a 401(k) with a 4% company match.

Equity plan 📦 Every Rainmaker gets an equity option plan so we all benefit from our success.

Health and Wellness 📚 High performance begins from within. Rainmakers receive a monthly stipend to be used for eligible health and wellness spending like gym memberships/fitness classes, massages, acupuncture - whatever recharges you!

In-office meals 🍜 Rainmakers working from the office enjoy lunch and dinner on us, covered with a DoorDash credit.

Team summits ✨ Summits play an important role at Rain. Time together helps us build relationships and a common destiny. Expect team and company offsites, both domestic and international.

Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

Your mission

At Bitpanda, resilience is key to keeping our business running, even when things go wrong. As a Resilience Manager, you'll help strengthen our Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery capabilities across the organization. You'll work closely with operational teams, drive improvements, and make sure we're prepared to respond to disruptions and recover effectively. This is a hands-on role where you'll take ownership, connect the dots across teams, and turn plans into practical solutions.

What you’ll do

  • Drive and continuously improve the Business Continuity Management (BCM) framework, maintaining reliable data, documentation, and reporting.
  • Work hands-on with cross-functional teams to develop, maintain, and test Business Continuity Plans (BCPs) and support Disaster Recovery planning.
  • Coordinate Business Impact Assessments (BIAs) to help teams identify critical processes, dependencies, and recovery requirements.
  • Actively participate in crisis management activities, simulations, and exercises to improve organizational readiness.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders, including risk management and auditors, to address requirements and drive resilience improvements.

Who you are

  • You have 4+ years of experience in Business Continuity Management, operational resilience, IT operations, risk management, or a related field.
  • You're a hands-on problem solver who takes ownership, challenge existing approaches when needed, and drives topics forward independently.
  • You understand how business processes, technology, people, and external dependencies fit together, and are comfortable working with different teams and stakeholders. 
  • You have an analytical, data-driven mindset and enjoy bringing structure to complex topics.
  • Experience with BCM, Disaster Recovery, crisis management, or regulatory frameworks such as DORA is a strong plus.

What’s in it for you

  • Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
  • Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.
  • Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.
  • Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.
  • Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
  • Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.
  • Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.
  • Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.
  • Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
  • Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
  • Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

       .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.
* These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).

About The Role

The Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team architects, builds, and maintains the rock-solid infrastructure that applications rely on. At the Senior Level, you own reliability, performance, and cost outcomes for the systems under your area end-to-end, not just executing well-defined tasks, but deciding between tradeoffs, scoping ambiguous problems, and driving process and system improvements that span teams. You'll work closely with development, security, and product teams, and mentor other engineers as a technical point of reference for the team.

What You Will Do

  • Own the availability, performance, scalability, and security of production systems end-to-end, across cloud (AWS/GCP) and on-premises environments.
  • Design and evolve Kubernetes deployment strategy for production workloads.
  • Own CI/CD and GitOps pipelines in production (ArgoCD or equivalent) and the Terraform that provisions the infrastructure behind them.
  • Diagnose and resolve database performance issues.
  • Build and maintain observability that surfaces problems before they become incidents.
  • Seek out and implement process and system improvements affecting performance and security, coordinating with multiple stakeholders.
  • Scope and lead medium-to-large infrastructure initiatives: gather requirements, prioritize by business impact, and communicate impact to stakeholders.
  • Negotiate technical tradeoffs with stakeholders to meet business SLAs.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to peers and junior engineers; promote best practices and standards across the team.
  • Maintain documentation and process discipline for the systems and incidents you own.
  • Lead structured incident investigation, isolating server, database, and application layers with a metrics-first approach, including on-call during high-traffic events.

What Are We Looking For

  • At least 4 years of experience in either SRE, DevOps, MLOps, or platform engineering, including senior-level scope at a high-traffic company.
  • Deep expertise in one major cloud provider (preferably AWS), with a proven ability to ramp up on the other quickly.Production experience & expertise with Kubernetes & Linux fundamentals
  • CI/CD & GitOps (ArgoCD or other equivalent stacks)
  • Database performance analysis & monitoring (MySQL, Postgres)
  • Observability tooling & standards (Datadog, OpenTelemetry)
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)
  • Strong working English, verbal & written communication. Strong documentation and process discipline.
  • On-call & incident handling experience during high-traffic events.
  • Comfortable negotiating with stakeholders to propose technical compromises that meet business SLAs.
  • Demonstrated growth mindset and proven ability to own ambiguous scope.

About Figure

Figure (NASDAQ: FIGR) is transforming capital markets through blockchain. We’re proving that blockchain isn’t just theory - it’s powering real products used by hundreds of thousands of consumers and institutions. 

By combining blockchain’s transparency and efficiency with AI-driven automation, we’ve reimagined how loans are originated, funded, and traded in secondary markets. From faster processing times to lower costs and reduced bias, our technology is helping borrowers, investors, and financial institutions achieve better outcomes.

Together with our 170+ partners, we’ve originated over $22 billion in home equity loans (HELOCs) on our blockchain-native platform, making Figure the largest non-bank provider of home equity financing in the U.S. Figure’s ecosystem also includes YLDS, an SEC-registered yield-bearing stablecoin that operates as a tokenized money market fund, and several other products and platforms that are reshaping consumer finance and capital markets. 

We’re proud to be recognized as one of Forbes’ Most Innovative Fintech Startups in 2025 and Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies in Finance and Personal Finance.

About the Role

Figure is seeking an exceptional, highly organized, and proactive Executive Assistant to support our Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer while overseeing the day-to-day operations of our New York City office of approximately 50 employees and growing. This is a dynamic, high-impact role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, exercises excellent judgment, and takes pride in making the people and teams around them more effective. The ideal candidate is a true self-starter who can anticipate needs, navigate complex logistics, manage competing priorities, and execute seamlessly with minimal oversight. No task is too big or too small; whether coordinating executive travel, organizing Board of Directors meetings, planning company offsites, or troubleshooting office issues, you approach every responsibility with ownership, professionalism, and attention to detail. Requires someone equally comfortable working closely with senior leadership and rolling up their sleeves to ensure the office runs smoothly.

What You'll Do

  • Provide comprehensive executive and administrative support to the CEO and CFO, serving as a trusted partner in managing their schedules, priorities, and day-to-day needs.
  • Own and proactively manage complex, frequently changing calendars, coordinating internal and external meetings across multiple time zones, anticipating conflicts, prioritizing competing demands, and coordinating engagements with investors, board members, and senior executives.
  • Manage complex domestic and international travel arrangements—including flights, hotels, ground transportation, detailed itineraries, and expense reports—while actively monitoring plans and adapting to delays or schedule changes.
  • Oversee daily operations of Figure's NYC office for ~50 employees as the primary contact for operational needs, office vendors, building management, supplies, equipment, workplace services, onboarding logistics, and ad-hoc IT support.
  • Plan and execute executive/departmental offsites, leadership gatherings, and NYC office events, managing budgets, venues, catering, agendas, and vendor relationships.
  • Take ownership of special projects and cross-functional initiatives to support leadership.

What We Look For

  • 5+ years of experience supporting C-suite executives in a fast-paced corporate environment, with proven ability to manage complex calendars, frequent travel, and competing priorities.
  • Experience coordinating high-level meetings involving board members, investors, or senior leadership.
  • Strong organizational skills, sound judgment, excellent written and verbal communication, high discretion, and proficiency in Google Workspace, Zoom, and Slack.
  • Ability to work on-site in our NYC office Monday through Thursday.
  • Preferred: Experience in publicly traded companies, financial services, fintech, or high-growth tech businesses, along with familiarity with board meeting coordination, corporate governance calendars, workplace operations, or event planning.
  • Proactive mindset that anticipates needs, owns outcomes, thrives in ambiguity, remains calm under pressure, maintains a no-task-too-small mentality, and brings positive energy.
  • Adhere to all company security policies and data handling procedures.
  • Complete mandatory security awareness training within required timeframes.
  • Promptly report any suspected security incidents or suspicious activity to the Security team.

Salary

  • Base Compensation Range: $95,200 - $142,800/yr
  • 25% annual bonus target, paid quarterly 
  • Company equity in the form of RSUs

This is the compensation range for the role in the United States. Actual compensation may vary based on a candidate’s experience, skills, location, internal equity, and evolving business needs. While most offers are generally made within the middle of the range, final compensation is determined based on the factors above.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employees and their dependents on select plans
  • Company HSA, FSA, Dependent Care FSA, 401(k), and commuter benefits
  • Employer-paid life and disability insurance
  • 11 observed holidays and PTO plan
  • Up to 12 weeks of paid family leave
  • Continuing education reimbursement

About Polymarket

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire.

About the Role

Polymarket US is hiring a Sanctions Compliance Officer to build and lead our sanctions compliance program and the operational screening function that supports it. This is a hands-on role within the Financial Crimes organization with responsibility for both program strategy and day-to-day operations across our growing U.S. business.

We are looking for someone who is both a deep sanctions subject matter expert and a strong operator. You should bring extensive knowledge of U.S. economic sanctions requirements, including OFAC regulations and guidance, as well as demonstrated experience building and running effective sanctions operations. You will own the policies, controls, screening framework, escalation standards, technology, and governance that support the sanctions program, while also building and leading a standalone sanctions team responsible for reviewing sanctions alerts.

This is not a purely advisory or policy role. The Sanctions Compliance Officer will be responsible for ensuring the program works effectively in practice, including establishing operational procedures, staffing and managing the screening team, setting productivity and quality standards, overseeing escalations, and continuously improving screening effectiveness.

The role will work closely with Legal, Compliance, KYC, AML, Product, Engineering, and Operations. You should be equally comfortable interpreting sanctions requirements for a new product or counterparty, designing a screening control, managing an operational queue, and diving into a complex sanctions escalation.

What You'll Do

Own and continuously enhance Polymarket US's sanctions compliance framework, including policies, procedures, governance, risk assessments, screening controls, escalation standards, and supporting documentation.

Serve as the company's primary sanctions subject matter expert, translating OFAC requirements, U.S. economic sanctions programs, regulatory developments, and emerging risks into practical controls and operational requirements.

Own the end-to-end sanctions screening framework across customers, transactions, counterparties, beneficial owners, and related parties, including requirements for list management, matching logic, thresholds, testing, quality assurance, and ongoing effectiveness reviews.

Build and lead the sanctions team responsible for executing the screening framework, including establishing staffing, workflows, procedures, escalation criteria, service levels, quality standards, and performance expectations.

Manage the investigation and disposition of sanctions screening alerts, including potential sanctions matches, ensuring decisions are consistent, well documented, and aligned with applicable requirements.

Develop and maintain escalation and decision frameworks for potential blocked or prohibited activity, partnering with Legal and senior Compliance leadership on significant matters and regulatory reporting where required.

Advise Legal, Compliance, Product, and business teams on sanctions risks associated with customers, counterparties, products, jurisdictions, transactions, and new business initiatives, including ownership and control considerations and application of OFAC's 50 Percent Rule.

Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to embed sanctions controls into onboarding, transaction flows, and other relevant product processes and to continuously improve screening effectiveness.

Establish a strong quality and testing framework to assess whether sanctions controls are operating as designed and to identify opportunities to improve accuracy, consistency, and efficiency.

Identify and implement opportunities to leverage AI and automation to improve the effectiveness, consistency, and efficiency of sanctions screening and alert reviews, while maintaining appropriate human oversight, controls, testing, and governance.

Ensure the sanctions function remains closely integrated with KYC, AML Investigations, Fraud, and other Financial Crimes teams.

What We're Looking For

8+ years of sanctions, financial crimes, AML, or related compliance experience, with significant direct responsibility for U.S. economic sanctions.

Deep subject matter expertise in OFAC regulations, sanctions programs, and guidance.

Demonstrated experience building or leading both a sanctions program and sanctions / financial crime screening operations within a regulated financial institution, FinTech, broker-dealer, derivatives firm, payments company, or similarly complex environment.

A combination of sanctions advisory and operational leadership experience - this role requires someone who can interpret complex requirements and build and manage the teams and processes used to execute them.

Experience leveraging AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve sanctions screening, alert review, investigations, or other financial crimes processes, with a practical understanding of appropriate governance, testing, and human oversight.

Hands-on experience with sanctions screening, alert investigation, escalation, disposition, and blocked or rejected transaction analysis.

Experience designing or overseeing sanctions screening systems, including matching logic, tuning, testing, list management, QA/QC, and false-positive reduction.

Experience establishing operational metrics, productivity expectations, quality programs, escalation frameworks, and queue-management processes.

Experience advising on sanctions risks associated with customers, counterparties, jurisdictions, transactions, products, and new business initiatives.

Demonstrated ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into clear, practical guidance and operational controls.

Experience drafting sanctions policies, procedures, risk assessments, escalation standards, and operational documentation.

Experience supporting regulatory exams, audits, investigations, or independent testing.

Strong judgment and the ability to independently assess and escalate complex sanctions matters.

Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate sanctions risks and recommendations to senior leadership and non-specialist stakeholders.

Ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving environment and build a program and operations function while the business continues to scale.

Plus

Prior experience working at the U.S. Department of the Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC)..

Experience at a CFTC- or NFA-registered entity, including a DCM, DCO, or FCM.

Experience with digital assets, blockchain analytics, or sanctions risks associated with crypto or blockchain-based activity.

Experience implementing or enhancing sanctions, PEP, and adverse media screening technology.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.
